vv84:1.1: Suṇotha yakkhassa ca vāṇijāna ca samāgamo yattha tadā ahosi yathā kathaṃ itarītarena cāpi subhāsitaṃ tañ ca suṇātha sabbe. || ||
vv84:2.1: Yo so ahu rājā Pāyāsi nāma Bhummānaṃ sahavyagato yasassī so modamāno va sake vimāne amānuso mānuse ajjhabhāsī ti. || ||
vv84:3.1: Vaṅke araññe amanussaṭṭhāne kantāre appodake appabhakkhe suduggame vaṇṇupathassa majjhe vaṅkaṃbhayā naṭṭhamanā manussā. || ||
vv84:4.1: Na-y-idha phalā mūlamayā ca santi upādānaṃ natthi kuto 'dha bhakkho aññatra paṃsūhi ca vālukāhi ca tattāhi uṇhāhi ca dāruṇāhi ca. || ||
vv84:5.1: Ujjaṅgalaṃ tattaṃ ivaṃ kapālaṃ anāyasaṃ paralokena tulyaṃ luddānaṃ āvāsam idaṃ purāṇaṃ bhūmippadeso abhisattarūpo. || ||
vv84:6.1: Atha tumhe kena vaṇṇena kim āsamānā imaṃ padesaṃ hi anuppaviṭṭhā sahasā samecca lobhā bhayā athavā sampamūḷhā ti. || ||
vv84:7.1: Magadhesu Aṅgesu ca satthavāhā āropayissaṃ paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ te yāmase Sindhu-Sovīrabhūmiṃ dhanatthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā. || ||
vv84:8.1: Divā pipāsaṃ 'nadhivāsayantā yoggānukampañ ca samekkhamānā etena vegena āyāma sabbe rattiṃ maggaṃ paṭipannā vikāle. || ||
vv84:9.1: Te duppayātā aparaddhamaggā andhākulā vippanaṭṭhā araññe suduggame vaṇṇupathassa majjhe disaṃ na jānāma pamūḷhacittā. || ||
vv84:10.1: Idañ ca disvāna adiṭṭhapubbaṃ vimānaseṭṭhañ ca tavañ ca yakkha tat uttariṃ jīvitam āsamānā disvā patītā sumanā udaggā ti. || ||
vv84:11.1: Pāraṃ samuddassa idañ ca vaṇṇuṃ vettācaraṃ saṅkupathañ ca maggaṃ nadiyo pana pabbatānañ ca duggā puthuddisā gacchatha bhogahetu. || ||
vv84:12.1: Pakkhandiyāna vijitaṃ paresaṃ verajjake mānuse pekkhamānā yaṃ vo sutaṃ vā athavā pi diṭṭhaṃ accherakaṃ taṃ vo suṇoma tātā ti. || ||
vv84:13.1: Ito pi accherataraṃ kumāra na no sutaṃ vā athavā pi diṭṭhaṃ atītamānussakam eva sabbaṃ disvā na tappāma anomavaṇṇaṃ. || ||
vv84:14.1: Vehāsayaṃ pokkharañño savanti pahūtamalyā bahupuṇḍarīkā dumā c' ime niccaphalūpapannā atīva gandhā surabhiṃ pavāyanti. || ||
vv84:15.1: Veḷuriyatthambhā satam ussitāse silāpavāḷassa ca āyataṃsā masāragallā sahā lohitaṅkā thambhā ime jotirasāmayāse. || ||
vv84:16.1: Sahassatthambhaṃ atulānubhāvaṃ tesūpari sādhu-m-idaṃ vimānaṃ ratanantaraṃ kañcanavedimissaṃ tapanīyapaṭṭehi ca sādhu channaṃ. || ||
vv84:17.1: Jambonaduttattam idaṃ sumaṭṭho pāsādasopānaphalūpapanno daḷho ca vaggu ca susaṅgato ca atīva nijjhānakhamo manuñño. || ||
vv84:18.1: Ratanantarasmiṃ bahuannapānaṃ parivārito accharāsaṅgaṇena muraja-āḷambaraturiyaghuṭṭo abhivandito 'si thutivandanāya. || ||
vv84:19.1: So modasi nārigaṇappabodhano vimānapāsādavare manorame acintiyo sabbaguṇūpapanno rājā yathā Vessavaṇo Naḷinyā. || ||
vv84:20.1: Devo nu āsi udavāsi yakkho udāhu devindo manussabhūto pucchanti taṃ vāṇijā satthavāhā ācikkha ko nāma tuvaṃ si yakkho ti. || ||
vv84:21.1: Serissako nāma aham hi yakkho kantāriyo vaṇṇupathamhi gutto imaṃ padesaṃ abhipālayāmi vacanakaro Vessavaṇassa rañño ti. || ||
vv84:22.1: Adhiccaladdhaṃ pariṇāmajan te sayaṃ kataṃ udāhu devehi dinnaṃ pucchanti taṃ vāṇijā satthavāhā kathaṃ tayā laddham idaṃ manuññan ti. || ||
vv84:23.1: Nādhiccaladdhaṃ na pariṇāmajaṃ me na sayaṃ kataṃ na hi devehi dinnaṃ sakehi kammehi apāpakehi puññehi me laddham idaṃ manuññan ti. || ||
vv84:24.1: Kin te vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko pucchanti taṃ vāṇijā satthavāhā kathaṃ tayā laddhaṃ idaṃ vimānan ti. || ||
vv84:25.1: Mamaṃ Pāyāsī ti ahū samaññā rajjaṃ yadā kārayiṃ Kosalānaṃ natthikadiṭṭhi kadariyo pāpadhammo ucchedavādī ca tadā ahosiṃ. || ||
vv84:26.1: Samaṇo ca kho āsi Kumārakassapo bahussuto cittakathī uḷāro so me tadā dhammakathaṃ akāsi diṭṭhivisūkāni vinodayī me. || ||
vv84:27.1: Tāhaṃ tassa dhammakathaṃ suṇitvā upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayissaṃ pāṇātipātā virato ahosiṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayissaṃ amajjapo no ca musā abhāṇiṃ sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho. || ||
vv84:28.1: Taṃ me vataṃ taṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko teh' eva kammehi apāpakehi puññehi me laddham idaṃ vimānan ti. || ||
vv84:29.1: Saccaṃ kirāhaṃsu narā sapaññā anaññathā vacanaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ yahiṃ yahiṃ gacchati puññakammo tahiṃ tahiṃ modati kāmakāmī. || ||
vv84:30.1: Yahiṃ yahiṃ sokapariddavo ca vadho ca bandho ca parikkileso tahiṃ tahiṃ gacchati pāpakammo na muccati duggatiyā kadācī ti. || ||
vv84:31.1: Sammūḷharūpo va jano ahosi asmiṃ muhutte kalalīkato va janass' imassa tuyhañ ca kumāra appaccayo kena nu kho ahosī ti. || ||
vv84:32.1: Ime pi sirīsavanā ca tātā dibbā gandhā surabhiṃ sampavanti te sampavāyanti imaṃ vimānaṃ divā ca ratto ca tamaṃ nihantā. || ||
vv84:33.1: Imesañ ca kho vassataccayena sipāṭikā phalati ekamekā mānussakaṃ vassasataṃ atītaṃ yadagge kāyamhi idhūpapanno. || ||
vv84:34.1: Disvān' ahaṃ vassasatāni pañca asmiṃ vimāne ṭhatvāna tātā āyukkhayā puññakkhayā cavissaṃ ten' eva sokena pamucchito 'smī ti. || ||
vv84:35.1: Kathaṃ nu soceyya tathāvidho so laddhā vimānaṃ atulaṃ cirāya ye cāpi kho ittaram upapannā te nūna soceyyuṃ parittapuññā ti. || ||
vv84:36.1: Anucchaviṃ ovadiyañ ca me taṃ yaṃ maṃ tumhe peyyavācaṃ vadetha tumhe ca kho tātā mayānuguttā yen' icchakaṃ tena paletha sotthin ti. || ||
vv84:37.1: Gantvā mayaṃ Sindhu-Sovīrabhūmiṃ dhanatthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā yathāpayogā paripuṇṇacāgā kāhāma Serissa mahaṃ uḷāran ti. || ||
vv84:38.1: Mā c' eva Serissa mahaṃ akattha sabbañ ca vo bhavissati yaṃ vadetha pāpāni kammāni vivajjayātha dhammānuyogañ ca adhiṭṭhahāthā ti. || ||
vv84:39.1: Upāsako atthi imamhi saṅghe bahussuto sīlavatūpapanno saddho ca cāgī ca supesalo ca vicakkhaṇo santusito mutīmā. || ||
vv84:40.1: Sañjānamāno na musā bhaṇeyya parūpaghātāya na cetayeyya vebhūtikaṃ pesuṇaṃ no kareyya saṇhañ ca vācaṃ sakhilaṃ bhaṇeyya. || ||
vv84:41.1: Sagāravo sapatisso vinīto apāpako adhisīle visuddho so mātaraṃ pitarañ cāpi jantu dhammena poseti ariyavutti. || ||
vv84:42.1: Maññe so mātāpitunnaṃ kāraṇā bhogāni pariyesati na attahetu mātāpitunnañ ca yo accayena nekkhammapoṇo carissati brahmacariyaṃ. || ||
vv84:43.1: Ujū avaṅko asaṭho amāyo na lesakappena ca vohareyya so tādiso sukatakammakārī dhamme ṭhito kinti labhetha dukkhaṃ. || ||
vv84:44.1: Taṃ kāraṇā pātukato 'mhi attanā tasmā dhammaṃ passatha vāṇijāse aññatra ten' iha bhasmī bhavetha andhākulā vippanaṭṭhā araññe, taṃ khippamānena lahuṃ parena sukho ha ve sappurisena saṅgamo ti. || ||
vv84:45.1: Kiṃ nāma so kiñca karoti kammaṃ kiṃ nāmadheyyaṃ kiṃ pana tassa gottaṃ mayam pi naṃ daṭṭhukām' amha yakkha yassānukampāya idhāgato 'si lābhā hi tassa yassa tuvaṃ pihesī ti. || ||
vv84:46.1: Yo kappako Sambhavanāmadheyyo upāsako kocchaphalūpajīvī jānātha naṃ tumhākaṃ pesiyo so mā kho naṃ hīḷittha supesalo so ti. || ||
vv84:47.1: Jānāmase yaṃ tvaṃ vadesi yakkha na kho naṃ jānāma sa ediso ti mayam pi naṃ pūjayissāma yakkha sutvāna tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ uḷāran ti. || ||
vv84:48.1: Ye kec' imasmiṃ satthe manussā daharā mahantā athavā pi majjhimā sabbe va te ālambantu vimānaṃ passantu puññāna phalaṃ kadariyā ti. || ||
vv84:49.1: Te tattha sabbe va: ahaṃ pure ti taṃ kappakaṃ tattha purakkhipitvā sabbe va te ālaṃbiṃsu vimānaṃ Masakkasāraṃ viya Vāsavassa. || ||
vv84:50.1: Te tattha sabbe va: ahaṃ pure ti upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayiṃsu pāṇātipātā viratā ahesuṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayiṃsu amajjapā no ca musā bhaṇiṃsu sakena dārena ca ahesuṃ tuṭṭhā. || ||
vv84:51.1: Te tattha sabbe va: ahaṃ pure ti upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayitvāpakkāmi sattho anumodamāno yakkhiddhiyā anumato punappunaṃ. || ||
vv84:52.1: Gantvāna te Sindhu-Sovīrabhūmiṃ dhanatthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā yathāpayogā paripuṇṇalābhā paccāgamuṃ Pāṭaliputtam akkhataṃ. || ||
vv84:53.1: Gantvāna te saṃ gharaṃ sotthivanto puttehi dārehi samaṅgibhūtā ānandī vittā sumanā patītā akaṃsu Serissa mahaṃ uḷāraṃ Serissakaṃ te pariveṇaṃ māpayiṃsu. || ||
vv84:54.1: Etādisā sappurisāna sevanā mahatthikā dhammaguṇāna sevanā ekassa atthāya upāsakassa sabbe va sattā sukhitā ahesun ti. || ||
